correctness.rationale: The two Gaussian constraints F(0)=0 and (F(r)−F(0))/r=0 have joint density asymptotic (π²a0a1r²)^−1. Conditioning forces F′(0)=−rT_r and F′(r)=rU_r, both dominated by sqrt(a2) ξ2, so the fourth moment is 2a2²r⁴; Kac–Rice yields ρ2(0,r)=2a2²r²/(π²a0a1)+O(r⁴). Dividing by first intensities gives q=2Γ(2s)^3/[Γ(s)Γ(3s)^2] and R=2[Γ(2s)^2/(Γ(s)Γ(3s))]^2. Duplication/triplication plus strictly convex trigamma imply (log J)″<0 with zero initial derivative, hence R decreases with s and increases with β. Similarly (log q)″<0, with derivative starting Euler gamma>0 and tending −∞, gives one s maximum. Independent symbolic digamma identity and 75-digit gamma roots confirmed β*=33.46961659962773 and q*=2.286840938832975, R_2=1/2; these finite computations do not prove all-β monotonicity.
